# Fundamental Electrical Knowledge – ASE Practice Question (VIDEO)


#### Description


Technician A and Technician B are discussing electrical fundamentals.


**Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?**
A) All electrical circuits are made up of a load, a source, a control, a circuit protection device and a path that connects them all.


B) Ohm’s Law teaches the relationship between voltage, resistance, and wattage.


C) If the voltage is reduced, the current flow is also reduced.


D) Voltage is the measure of electromotive potential between any two points in a circuit.
